# R04 IsOS skill-selection cases

[中文](README_cn.md) · [Owner contract](../../../../../docs/isos/interfaces/packages/process.md) · [Design](../../../../../docs/isos/design/packages.md)

`cases.json` freezes the IsOS design boundary; it is not a passing implementation claim. Baseline: a saved `0.1.0` graph with one role-selected EOS `@v0.1` component, explicit schema-2 V2 generation, verified P01 `kind:"skill"` release `example/native-skill@0.1.0`, one regular `lib/island/skills/example.skill.so`, and an EOS stub advertising `host-skill-abi-v2`. The file `selection.example.json` shows the exact generated shape with synthetic digest and path placeholders; tests replace them with real hashes and private paths. No guest code runs while these fixtures are parsed.

The implementation maps each case ID to a unit or stubbed cross-owner integration test and records commands, exact IsOS/EOS commits and full output under ignored `logs/test/<run-id>/`. Success requires the exact generated file in the manifest, P04 generation recomputation, P01 revalidation, EOS-only environment delivery and a ready catalog only after EOS verifies and stages the selected bytes. Every pre-stop failure preserves old PIDs, active revision, run ID and R03 grants. A later EOS worker rejection is recorded under the candidate run, not falsely reported as a pre-stop IsOS failure. P01/P04/P05 codes retain precedence. EOS tests independently cover ABI size negotiation, invalid descriptor, capability denial and worker reap.

Negative graph, package, feature and snapshot cases freeze exact `{code,stage,path}` expectations in the machine table. R04-I04 checks `bridge` and `config` separately because both may have `role:"eos"` without being the selected runtime.

`catalog-setting.example.json` freezes the IsOS-owned `@v0.1` setting metadata after EOS adds generic object-array support. Run `python3 tests/fixtures/skill_selection/check_cases.py` to validate case IDs, both example schemas and bilingual links.

## Candidate catalog preflight cases

[`preflight_cases.json`](preflight_cases.json) freezes 18 IsOS owner-side cases against the independently approved [EOS preflight design](../../../../../docs/eos/interfaces/skills/native/host-abi.md#private-candidate-catalog-preflight-eos-implementation-slice). R04-IPF07 exercises the earlier IsOS selected-pin graph gate with a linked P01-valid release; it does not invoke the EOS probe. The success and rejection objects are synthetic, closed one-line protocol examples. A case is a frozen unit, stub or cross-owner replay requirement; the checker alone is not passing implementation evidence. The scoped exact merged-tip EOS/MuJoCo replay passed confirmed and unknown old Stop, retry fences, retained-log rotation, and an exact grant-token scan; see the [qualification evidence](../../../../../docs/isos/design/packages.md) for limits. Use an old serving run and record its PID set, run ID, active revision, R03 grants and run scope before each failure injection. Confirm checked candidate-grant retirement and probe-process reap before accepting a clean rejection. Capture first preflight failure through the manager-session correlation ID; a candidate run cursor is not published yet. The global deadline is 90 seconds. A probe success must be followed by the pre-stop byte/grant recheck and independent EOS launch admission. R05/R06 physical stop ordering remains a separate gate.

Run `python3 tests/fixtures/skill_selection/preflight_cases.py` to check case IDs and the strict result examples. The script does not execute EOS or prove the transaction. Save integration commands, full output, exact IsOS/EOS commits and observed child PIDs in ignored `logs/test/<run-id>/`.

## Successful-probe old-stop retirement cases

[`retirement_cases.json`](retirement_cases.json) freezes six IsOS cases after private `ok:true` and final pre-stop recheck. They compose with the separate R06 checked stop contract; the unknown-Restart candidate-retirement gap in R06 [#57](https://github.com/Island-Team/isos/pull/57) was implemented in R04 [#58](https://github.com/Island-Team/isos/pull/58). A confirmed old terminal permits exactly one candidate scope publication. An unknown old terminal blocks both candidate and recovery launch, leaves the old run identity and saved graph bytes unchanged, reports degraded status and a run-scoped `deployment_stop_unconfirmed`, and checks retirement of the unpublished candidate grant. Old PIDs need not remain unchanged after Stop begins. Candidate-retirement uncertainty takes response precedence as `skill_catalog_preflight_cleanup_unconfirmed` at empty path while preserving the live old R06 reason; marker-write faults must still leave a blocking orphan directory. The same Restart correlation ID must label the `source:isos` old-run stop event and, when present, the `source:isos` manager-session cleanup failure; P07 current view remains the old run. A same-manager retry retains the old reason, while manager restart recovers the same run ID as unknown with `stop_interrupted` or `stop_result_persist_failed`. Retry never allocates a new candidate. The checker validates the cases' shape. IsOS unit fault injection and a scoped live EOS/MuJoCo replay passed; broader cross-owner R04 qualification remains open before its TODO closes. Full output is in ignored `logs/test/20261102-r04-retirement-review-fix/` in IsOS and `logs/test/20261102-r04-live-retirement/` in EOS.
